The '''governing council of Salline''' led the port [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salline/Legends|Salline]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], it protested the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] arrest of its citizens and was declared to be traitorous by Chandrila's governor.<ref name="Handbook" />
